name: all-web-to-md
description: 网页转 Markdown 工具：DOM 解析 + 截图 OCR + 大模型排版优化

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @web2md/server" "npm run dev -w @web2md/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @web2md/server && npm run build -w @web2md/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @web2md/server && npm run typecheck -w @web2md/web
